授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: The lecture is conducted in person.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Computational methods to solve linear and non-linear equations, to approximate linear systems, to calculate integration and differentiation, and also calculate eigenvalues and eigenvectors of matrices are explained in the course.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Numerical Calculation, Simulation, Equations, Matrix, Approximation, Numerical Integration, Numerical Differentiation, Eigenvalues
